applicability; a role, conversation or resumption change alone invalidates
nothing. An invalidator invalidates the affected result before reliance,
even where the subject's own bytes are unchanged, preserving its
predecessor/successor relation and any demonstrably independent surviving
results. Invalidation withdraws the result from direct reliance; whether
its evidence is retained on the new basis is decided by `retain_applicable`
of FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse, and the changed
coordinate alone establishes neither that the claim fails nor that it
holds. The invalidators are three:

- a material input change: a change to the result's subject or to an
  input it rests on, including the admissible evidence that bears on its
  predicate; newly acquired or changed admissible evidence is such a
  change when it is material to the result as
  [FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#2-ontology) defines material, that is,
  when it could change the result's value;
- a changed basis: a change to any coordinate of the basis the result
  binds (FOUNDATIONS §2, Basis);
- a declared revising observation: an observation that the result or
  judgment itself names as one that would revise it, once it occurs.","section":"urn:a-c:project:3b3866ff050726ef7dd4e720f1dfc821ffa0e8a96b40c085a9f4b152f6b1ed1b/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.2/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F7.%20Closed%20result%20and%20reuse","start_line":1707}],"statement":"Check exact applicability before reuse. Their current material state decides what the work has and has not done.","exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":1469,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.2/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","quote":"The workspace and its authoritative inputs persist across activations and
are the continuing truth surface of the work: the surface whose current
material state decides what the work has and has not done. An actor's
context is an account of that state. It is bounded, because it is a
projection of the state (§2); revisable, because an observation can
correct it; and disposable, because a step records its closed results and
step-produced facts before it returns (§1 Admission; P4b). An account is
never a second truth surface, and no later activation needs a prior
actor's context: its intake reconstructs the governing relations without
it (§1 Intake) (P0, P3, P6).","section":"urn:a-c:project:3b3866ff050726ef7dd4e720f1dfc821ffa0e8a96b40c085a9f4b152f6b1ed1b/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.2/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F5.%20Work%20state%20and%20restart%2FThe%20workspace%20and%20an%20actor%27s%20account","start_line":1460}],"label":"Persistent current work state"}}}

A durable ticket is created or updated only when the carrier-selection table requires surviving state and the actor holds ticket-state authority. applicability rather than re-author unchanged judgment. Reuse and
invalidation are
[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse): changed material
inputs, a declared revising observation or a changed basis invalidate
the affected result, preserving the original result and its successor
relation and keeping only demonstrably independent results, and a new
role or conversation alone invalidates nothing. For a recorded judgment
the material inputs include its supporting computed facts and evidence,
and its declared revising observation is the one the record states;
reassessment covers what the change affects. The result may reference
current C outputs; reuse cannot silently turn unknown facts into
established premises (P4b, P5). Required independent assessment may consume valid C, but

continuation: bind its current question, subject and basis, result and evidence
references, and surviving obligations. Apply
[ACTIVATION §2](ACTIVATION.md#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope) to that
bounded acquisition, [§5](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart) to current
work state, the disposable actor account and resumption, and
[§7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse) to closed results and reuse.
The ticket retains its [work-state authority](#one-truth-state-projection-and-drift-refusal-up-009);
an actor's account cannot replace the carrier, governing sources or current
evidence. Preserve results, step-produced facts and owner rulings through
the named result and evidence surface under existing admission and
[continuity](#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity) law. This applies
those owners to the selected carrier; it creates no additional carrier
requirement and confers no ticket-state authority (P0, P3, P4b, P6).","section":"urn:a-c:project:3b3866ff050726ef7dd4e720f1dfc821ffa0e8a96b40c085a9f4b152f6b1ed1b/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.2/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F5.%20From%20carrier%20to%20execution%2FCarrier%20selection","start_line":731},{"end_line":1388,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.2/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","quote":"Resumption is re-entry of the same method over the current work state,
starting from the current material state, by a possibly different actor.
It recovers applicable progress, re-checks the invalidators of each reused
result (§7), reopens only affected support, and reconciles uncertain
external effects, sufficiently for the next dependent action, before any
repetition or dependent action. Resumption does not imply idempotence: an
action whose external effect may have occurred is not repeated blindly;
the lawful next moves are reconciliation, yield or stop.","section":"urn:a-c:project:3b3866ff050726ef7dd4e720f1dfc821ffa0e8a96b40c085a9f4b152f6b1ed1b/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.2/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F5.%20Work%20state%20and%20restart","start_line":1381}],"kind":"applies_restart_owner","meaning":"The selected carrier applies ACTIVATION section 5 to current work state, the disposable actor account and resumption. Reconcile uncertain external effects sufficiently for the next dependent action before any repetition or dependent action; resumption does not imply idempotence. An actor's account cannot replace the carrier, governing sources or current evidence."},"scope":["urn:a-c:generation:13c1d78232c8476f3fa7ab22:scope:source-corpus"],"source":"urn:a-c:generation:13c1d78232c8476f3fa7ab22:record:506fd7a6c08047be02a377c726fce4a3","target":"urn:a-c:generation:13c1d78232c8476f3fa7ab22:record:57361859f388e83cd86f0dae082dc3b7"}}

clauses.statement: The selected carrier applies ACTIVATION section 5 to current work state, the disposable actor account and resumption. Resume from current material state, recover applicable progress, re-check reused-result invalidators and reopen only affected support. Reconcile uncertain external effects sufficiently for the next dependent action before any repetition or dependent action; resumption does not imply idempotence. An actor's account cannot replace the carrier, governing sources or current evidence.

It is not a second truth surface and the next activation need not inherit it.","exceptions":[],"grounding":[{"end_line":1469,"path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.2/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","quote":"The workspace and its authoritative inputs persist across activations and
are the continuing truth surface of the work: the surface whose current
material state decides what the work has and has not done. An actor's
context is an account of that state. It is bounded, because it is a
projection of the state (§2); revisable, because an observation can
correct it; and disposable, because a step records its closed results and
step-produced facts before it returns (§1 Admission; P4b). An account is
never a second truth surface, and no later activation needs a prior
actor's context: its intake reconstructs the governing relations without
it (§1 Intake) (P0, P3, P6).","section":"urn:a-c:project:3b3866ff050726ef7dd4e720f1dfc821ffa0e8a96b40c085a9f4b152f6b1ed1b/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.2/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F5.%20Work%20state%20and%20restart%2FThe%20workspace%20and%20an%20actor%27s%20account","start_line":1460}],"label":"Disposable actor account"}}}

clauses.statement: Disposable actor account: An actor context is a bounded and revisable account of work state, disposable because a step records its closed results and step-produced facts before it returns. It is not a second truth surface and the next activation need not inherit it.
